      • bulkImportAccounts

        public static boolean bulkImportAccounts​(java.io.File file)
        Bulk imports accounts from a file Formats accepted: JSON:

        {"accounts":[ {"nickname":"Account1", "username":"test@test.com", "password":"password1234", "pin":"1234", "totp":"totp key"}, {"nickname":"Account1", "username":"test@test.com", "password":"password1234", "pin":"1234"}, {"nickname":"Account1", "username":"test@test.com", "password":"password1234", "totp":"totp key"}, {"nickname":"Account1", "username":"test@test.com", "password":"password1234"}, {"username":"test@test.com", "password":"password1234", "pin":"1234", "totp":"totp key"}, {"username":"test@test.com", "password":"password1234", "pin":"1234"}, {"username":"test@test.com", "password":"password1234", "totp":"totp key"}, {"username":"test@test.com", "password":"password1234"} ]} order agnostic nickname optional: defaults to username pin optional: defaults to empty totp optional: defaults to empty

        Colon Delimited: test@test.com:password1234 Account1:test@test.com:password1234 Account1:test@test.com:password1234:1234 Account1:test@test.com:password1234:1234:totp key Account1:test@test.com:password1234::totp key Given only username:password results in nickname defaulting to username

        Parameters:
        file - The file containing the accounts formatted correctly
        Returns:
        true if we are able to read the file, false otherwise

      • getAccountHash

        public static java.lang.String getAccountHash()
        Hashes the selected account's identifier, which is allowed in SDN scripts (unlike getUsername) This will check for Character ID first, and if that is not present it will use the Account username (email)
        Returns:
        A Base64 encoded SHA-256 hash of the account's identifier if a valid account is selected, otherwise returns an empty string
